entries.subject: Visible and near-infrared albedo
entries.finding: The selected Golish/USGS maps provide 550 and 950 nm normalized MSI albedo views. The retained 550 nm native label was inspected: 10682×5341 float samples, FilterNumber 1, Center 550 nm, and Equirectangular, planetocentric, east-positive 0–360° mapping centered at 180°. The filename contains sinu, but the label declares the selected projection. Its 17 km cartographic reference radius and 10 m/pixel sampling are not the body’s physical radius or guaranteed terrain resolution. The two bands remain separate, not a mineral-abundance ratio.

entries.subject: Shape and Elevation
entries.finding: [Gaskell ver128q](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/non_mission/gaskell.ast-eros.shape-model/data/vertex/ver128q.tab), 196,608 released facets. Elevation is radius minus 8.42 km, not gravitational height.

entries.subject: Named features
entries.finding: [IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature](https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Page/EROS/target) Eros centre-point export, snapshot 2026-09-11, public domain. IAU-adopted names with centre, diameter, extent and name origin; labels appear at the closest zoom only, and a selected feature stays labelled.
